premise: Maya asks the excavator for one scoop of soil for the printer and it won't stop — scoop, scoop, scoop — until the buggy's seats are full and she finds the words that stop it.
inspiration: Goethe's 'The Sorcerer's Apprentice' and Grimm's 'Sweet Porridge', where nobody can stop the magic, turned: the magic words are just 'thank you'.
lesson: Saying thank you tells a helper the job is done.

en-US.title: One Scoop, Please
en-US.text: {woman:enter} Maya needed moon soil for the {printer:enter} printer. Just a little, carried over in the {buggy:enter} buggy. {woman:face happy} {woman:says} “One scoop, please!” she told the {excavator:enter} excavator. {excavator:live} Its drums spun round and scooped up a big grey load. {sfx:scoop} {excavator:go to buggy} It rolled over to the buggy and tipped it into a seat. {buggy:dust-puff} {woman:face surprised} [short pause] Then it went back for another. {excavator:live} Scoop! {woman:says} [rushed] “Stop!” Scoop. {buggy:wobble} “Halt!” Scoop. {buggy:shake} “ENOUGH!” {excavator:live hold} The excavator held up yet another full scoop, ready to go. {buggy:dust-puff} Both seats were heaped with dust, and Maya {woman:face sad} [sighs] sighed. Then she {woman:face happy} smiled. Maybe it was just waiting to hear that the job was done. {woman:says} [warmly] “Thank you!” {excavator:live resume} The excavator lowered its scoop and stood still. {printer:live} [giggles] {woman:hop x2} And the printer had enough soil for a week.

es-ES.title: Una palada, por favor
es-ES.text: {woman:enter} Maya necesitaba tierra lunar para la {printer:enter} impresora. Solo un poquito, para llevarla en el {buggy:enter} buggy. {woman:face happy} {woman:says} «¡Una palada, por favor!», le dijo a la {excavator:enter} excavadora. {excavator:live} Sus tambores giraron y recogieron un buen montón gris. {sfx:scoop} {excavator:go to buggy} Fue hasta el buggy y lo echó en un asiento. {buggy:dust-puff} {woman:face surprised} [short pause] Luego volvió a por otra. {excavator:live} ¡Palada! {woman:says} [rushed] «¡Para!» Palada. {buggy:wobble} «¡Alto!» Palada. {buggy:shake} «¡BASTA!» {excavator:live hold} La excavadora levantó otra palada llena, lista para seguir. {buggy:dust-puff} Los dos asientos rebosaban de polvo, y Maya {woman:face sad} [sighs] suspiró. Luego {woman:face happy} sonrió. A lo mejor solo esperaba oír que el trabajo estaba hecho. {woman:says} [warmly] «¡Gracias!» {excavator:live resume} La excavadora bajó la pala y se quedó quieta. {printer:live} [giggles] {woman:hop x2} Y la impresora tuvo tierra para toda la semana.

scoop.prompt: a big scoop of dry gritty soil being dug and lifted by a machine, a crunchy rushing scrape
